{{Quote|Here's what probably happened. He came up here, the tree fell on him, and he reinitialized. When he was online again, his memories were cross-linked or corrupted.|Female Pop-Dog guard on the maintenance droid|<ref name="MK" />}}
A '''maintenance droid''' operated at an abandoned mine at the western edge of the area where [[Chakham Army Base]] was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> he somehow became trapped beneath a fallen tree and was found by two [[Pop-Dogs|Pop-Dog]] guards during their patrol. When one of the guards, a [[Unidentified female Quarren Pop-Dog|Quarren]], questioned him about how he had become trapped, the maintenance droid answered that he did not know. The Quarren's [[Unidentified female Human Pop-Dog (Kuratooine)|partner]] surmised that the tree had fallen on him, causing the droid to reinitialize and potentially cross-link or corrupt his memories. The Pop-Dogs then dragged the tree completely clear, after which the maintenance droid followed them as they departed, continuing to complain about their interpretation of events.<ref name="MK" />
